title: Mega Man X8
subtitle: PlayStation 2 / PC · X / Axl / Zero
intro: Eight armor capsules and twenty Rare Metals, including Noah’s Park. Follow the weakness loop, then return with the right pair and equipment. Rare Metals unlock R&D purchases; they are not immediately usable upgrades.

stages.name: Bamboo Pandamonium
stages.tip: Stay outside his punch range and use charged Buster shots. When he enters Overdrive, prioritize dodging his lethal lunge rather than finishing your attack.
stages.now: Icarus Legs now; return for 3 Rare Metals

items.name: Icarus · Leg Parts
items.text: After the first Ride Armor battle room, use the lift to raise Chimera. Air-dash left toward the high spiked ledge, eject near the end, then double-jump with Zero to reach it. Switch to X at the capsule.
items.when: Collect on the planned visit

items.name: Weapon Converter · X
items.text: Copy the legless hovering enemy with Axl. At the branching routes, leave the Ride Armor and take the lowest path. Roll through the tiny lower-left opening in the copied form.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

items.name: Double Barrier · Axl
items.need: X; Buster I/H + Crystal Wall; Chimera
items.text: Take Chimera through the blue-crate route. Eject so it passes below the low platform on the spike conveyor, then reboard and jump to safety. Use the blue switch to raise Chimera on the lift; break the upper crates and cast charged Crystal Wall inside the alcove.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

items.name: Shield Armor · Zero
items.need: Axl; hovering-enemy copy; Chimera; Prickle Barrier
items.text: Beyond the second Ride Armor battle room, cross the lowering platforms to the spike conveyor. Let Chimera travel beneath the low roof. Eject, transform into the rolling copy, and follow it using a fresh Prickle Barrier to survive the spike contact. Cancel the copy at the far side, reboard, then ride the background lift to the Rare Metal.
items.extra: Buy a fresh Prickle Barrier before trying; it protects one spike contact, not unlimited time on spikes.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

stages.name: Optic Sunflower
stages.tip: Use Green Spinner when the boss is exposed. Move out of the laser pattern before attacking; Double Attack can finish a dangerous opening.
stages.now: Converter now; return for armor and score rewards

items.name: Weapon Converter · Zero
items.text: Late in the connecting hallways, cross the large chasm toward the lower ledge on the far side. Hover beneath the upper platform rather than taking the normal high route.
items.when: Collect on the planned visit

items.name: Hermes · Buster Parts
items.text: After the fourth test, climb toward the barrier high above the hallway. Remove it with Squeeze Bomb and enter the capsule alcove.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

items.name: Life Tank unlock
items.text: Finish all eight tests with five, six or seven results in the top row, then enter the prize room. Collect this reward on a separate run from the perfect-score reward.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

items.name: Metal Generator
items.text: Earn the highest result in every test during one run. The prize room awards Metal Generator instead of the 5–7-result Rare Metal.
items.extra: Return with stronger equipment; clearing the rooms slowly is not enough for the top row.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

stages.name: Dark Mantis
stages.tip: Use Shining Ray as he appears. Avoid his claw and scythe paths, and change character promptly if he grabs you.
stages.now: Hermes Body now; return after restoring power

items.name: Hermes · Body Parts
items.text: In the last tall shaft with descending crates and lasers, climb upward instead of descending toward the boss. Enter the narrow right passage at the top.
items.when: Collect on the planned visit

items.name: Life Tank unlock
items.text: Open the hidden generator room using Axl’s guard disguise and salute. Cast charged Crystal Wall on the floor directly in front of the generator.
items.extra: See the generator instructions below before searching the dark corridors.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

items.name: Shield Armor · Axl
items.text: After powering the generator, backtrack across the pit and around the corner. Climb the now-visible hanging platforms; take the metal from the fourth one to the right.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

items.name: D Glaive · Zero
items.need: X + Axl; Icarus Legs; lights on
items.text: After powering the generator, drop down the pit outside and follow the corridor to its exit door. Jump onto the small ledge above that door, then the higher ledge offscreen.
items.extra: Collecting this unlocks the D Glaive purchase; it does not equip Zero automatically.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

stages.name: Gravity Antonion
stages.tip: Keep clear of falling blocks and use Shadow Runner to track him. Watch which surface becomes the floor before committing to a jump.
stages.now: Head + B Fan now; return for K Knuckle

items.name: Icarus · Head Parts
items.text: Copy a spike-skating enemy early. In the room with three shielded flying enemies, use the left and right gravity switches to expose the spike corridor. Cross in the copy form, drop to the hidden teleporter and switch to X at the capsule.
items.when: Collect on the planned visit

items.name: B Fan · Zero
items.text: Near the end, enter the second moving-block room. Use the spike-skater form to descend past the two red metals to the spiked lower corner containing the Rare Metal.
items.when: Collect on the planned visit

items.name: K Knuckle · Zero
items.text: In the large stationary staircase room, double-jump onto the isolated block high on the left. Switch to X and cast charged Crystal Wall on top.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

stages.name: Earthrock Trilobyte
stages.tip: Use Squeeze Bomb to break his crystal defense. Dodge the ground attacks and attack the exposed body rather than firing repeatedly into armor.
stages.now: 2 metals now; return with fire and charged Crystal Wall

items.name: Life Bottle Full unlock
items.text: During the opening robot chase, climb over the large skeleton. Jump through the floating metal trail and hover past the red metal to reach the Rare Metal before the robot destroys your footing.
items.when: Collect on the planned visit

items.name: Double Barrier · Zero
items.need: Activate the crane on the way out
items.text: Shoot the crane switch before the robot reaches it during the uphill chase. Once the robot retreats, cross the suspended girders toward the far-left crane for the Rare Metal.
items.when: Collect on the planned visit

items.name: Icarus · Body Parts
items.text: On the return chase, the robot breaks the boulder that blocked an uphill alcove. Burn the fuel canisters with Melt Creeper and enter with X.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

items.name: Metal Discount
items.text: Follow the retreating robot back over the plateau. It opens the metal-covered depression in the ground. Drop into that hollow and cast charged Crystal Wall.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

stages.name: Gigabolt Man-O-War
stages.tip: In the city chase, fire continuously when aligned and boost to maintain pressure. In the ground fight, Crystal Wall exploits his weakness; avoid the electric lines.
stages.now: No permanent field pickups in Dynasty

stages.name: Avalanche Yeti
stages.tip: Use Thunder Dancer between his ice attacks. Keep moving through safe gaps when he covers the arena; avoid getting pinned at the wall.
stages.now: Hermes Head now; Axl + Zero return for the metal

items.name: Hermes · Head Parts
items.text: After the Ride Chaser breaks into the hideout, double-jump onto the high ledge above the entrance with Zero. Switch to X, melt the ice with Shining Ray and approach the capsule.
items.when: Collect on the planned visit

items.name: Shock Absorber · Zero
items.text: At the same end-of-bike area, double-jump to the upper ledge with Zero. Switch to Axl and hover back left to the top of the entrance gate.
items.extra: Use a separate Axl + Zero visit; the armor capsule requires X.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

stages.name: Burn Rooster
stages.tip: Strike with Drift Diamond during openings and dodge the fire trails. After the boss, stay alert: the escape climb is still part of the stage.
stages.now: 3 pickups now; return after buying T Breaker

items.name: Hermes · Leg Parts
items.text: During the spike-and-pipe shaft, descend past the visible capsule. After the electric-field enemy, find the left wall passage and climb back up to the alcove.
items.when: Collect on the planned visit

items.name: T Breaker · Zero
items.text: Copy the flying enemy at the bottom of the spike shaft. Return toward the top, where two bats mark a small opening high on the left. Fly through in the copy form and collect the Rare Metal.
items.when: Collect on the planned visit

items.name: Weapon Tank unlock
items.text: After the second fiery-enemy battle room, climb UP the falling platforms before the next shaft scrolls downward. Hover right at the top to enter the hidden room and defeat its guards.
items.when: Collect on the planned visit

items.name: Double Barrier · X
items.text: Return after buying T Breaker. In the pipe-and-spike shaft, use its standing Special attack on the cracked floor indicated by Pallette. Drop through and break the crate below.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

sideStages.name: Noah’s Park
sideStages.now: Revisit after the first Maverick; return again with Icarus Head
sideStages.tip: Bring X + Zero for the early Buster and waterfall visit. These three pickups count toward the full 28, but Noah’s Park is not one of the eight Maverick stages.

items.name: Icarus · Buster Parts
items.text: Return to the building where Zero joined during the opening. Its previously closed door is now open; walk in with X to collect the capsule.
items.when: Collect on the planned visit

items.name: Weapon Bottle Full unlock
items.text: Beyond the large outdoor gap, jump up behind the waterfall onto the hidden high rock ledge.
items.when: Collect on the planned visit

items.name: Shock Absorber · Axl
items.text: Outside the bat-filled cave, break the boulders sealing the upper alcove with Icarus Head’s jumping field. Climb into the opening for the metal.
items.when: Return with the listed team and equipment

extraSections:
Pitch Black · switch on the lights

  1. Bring Axl with Plasma Gun and X with Icarus Legs plus charged Crystal Wall.
  2. After two adjacent searchlights, defeat the sword-carrying guard with Copy Shot. Collect its DNA Core.
  3. Past the next corner and turret, cross the pit instead of dropping. Climb to the hidden side opening and find the sleeping guard.
  4. Transform into the guard. Stand in front of him and press Special to salute; follow him through the door.
  5. Fire Plasma Gun into the generator until the lighting stabilizes. Cast charged Crystal Wall in front of it for the buried Rare Metal, then collect the newly visible platform rewards outside.

R&D · health, tanks and purchases

No loose hearts or EX Tank: buy Life Up for each hunter, then its follow-up levels. Rare Metals reveal new development options; pay the Metal cost before relying on the ability.

Life-restoring Rare Metals fill the Life Bottle Full and two Life Tank unlocks as you collect them; weapon-restoring metals fill Weapon Bottle Full and Weapon Tank. Their displayed names can depend on collection order. Collect all three life-related locations and both weapon-related locations, then check R&D for both tanks.

PriorityReason
Life Ups + Super RecoverImprove survival for the active pair. Speedy Recovery helps reserve healing.
Life Tanks / Weapon TankBuild the unlocked tanks; use Life Charge / Weapon Charge to refill at base.
T BreakerRequired for the ordinary cracked-floor method in Inferno. Buy after finding its Rare Metal.
Metal Discount10% off later development. Buy before expensive armor and navigator upgrades if pursuing full completion.
Prickle BarrierOne spike-contact safeguard. Replace after use, especially before the Booster Forest conveyor method.
Retry ChipsExtra checkpoint attempts. Stock these before the final stages.

Zero’s D Glaive, K Knuckle, B Fan and T Breaker each require their field metal and a separate purchase. Sigma Blade is a New Game+ purchase. Ordinary shop upgrades are not additional hidden stage locations.

Useful tips · no exploits

  • Refill tanks at R&D with Life Charge and Weapon Charge before a difficult mission. This avoids an enemy-farming detour.
  • Play the Central White intermission when it appears for repeatable Metal rewards; aim for the bonus carriers. Earn and buy Metal Discount before long development sessions.
  • Use Axl’s unlimited weapon ammunition to learn boss patterns. Tag out while red recoverable health remains.
  • Most shields can be broken with X’s charged Buster or Zero’s combo-finishing hit. Do not waste the entire special-weapon bar against a closed guard.
  • Buy Prickle Barrier for spike routes, but treat it as a single safety charge. Avoid infinite-Metal bugs and unattended farming; neither is required here.
  • For Troia top ranks, bring developed weapons and use Double Attack where it clears a crowded test quickly. Review the results row after each room.

Jakob, Gateway & the final battles

FightDo this
VileUse Drift Diamond / Ice Gatling / Hyoryuushou. Change Character immediately if caught.
Jakob / GatewayManage shielded enemies and elevator waves; refill before the eight-boss rematch sequence. Reuse the weakness table.
SigmaBreak his guard before dealing sustained damage. Watch the sword and wall-jump away from sweeping attacks.
LumineRecognize the borrowed Maverick patterns; attack between them instead of chasing through the hazard.
Lumine’s final formHit when the wings open. During Paradise Lost, break the wing defense with barrier-breaking attacks and finish before the darkness closes in. Keep Axl active for the final hit if pursuing White Axl.

Normal and Hard include Lumine. Easy ends after Sigma, so it cannot complete this guide’s ending/unlock route. On Hard, extra story events can force solo sections; develop both members of the final pair.

Special forms & New Game+

Before the final battle: save separately, develop Axl to 100%, and bring him to finish Lumine’s final form. Finish with Axl active; a Double Attack is not required for White Axl.

UnlockNormal / Hard route
Ultimate Armor XCollect all eight parts and develop X to 100%; clear the game and continue its New Game+ data. Select the unlocked form on X’s character screen.
Black ZeroContinue a Normal/Hard clear into New Game+ and develop Zero to 100%, including the available Sigma Blade purchase.
White Axl100% Axl development plus Axl’s final hit on Lumine’s final form; save clear data and continue New Game+.
Sigma BladeAvailable to develop at R&D in New Game+; finding a separate hidden capsule is unnecessary.
Playable navigatorsUse Alia, Layer and Pallette as navigators; in New Game+ buy their unlocked weapons at R&D. The most-used navigator becomes available first; use the others on subsequent missions and check the shop.

Save clear data into a different slot so the pre-final run remains available. Special forms and navigator development extend beyond the 28 field pickups. Alia cannot wear X’s armor, and Pallette cannot replace Axl’s copying ability on item routes.

routeIntro: Recommended: Normal, X + Zero for the first Booster Forest visit. All three hunters are available after the opening, but only two travel together. This is a dependable collection route, not a minimum-visit speedrun.

routes.name: Standard · both armor sets and every Rare Metal
routes.subtitle: Weapon chain + planned returns
routes.description: Get Icarus Legs early, then unlock charged special weapons at Noah’s Park.

steps.title: 01 Bamboo · X + Zero
steps.text: Keep the Chimera Ride Armor to reach Icarus Legs. Use basic charged shots against the boss. Leave the copy-only and charged-Crystal-Wall metals for later.

steps.title: Return to Noah’s Park · X + Zero
steps.text: After the first Maverick clear, collect Icarus Buster and the waterfall Rare Metal. Equip Buster I before future charged-special-weapon methods.

steps.title: 02 Sunflower → 03 Mantis → 04 Antonion
steps.text: Use X + Axl for hover and copy routes. Take Hermes Body at Mantis, then Icarus Head and B Fan at Antonion. Some Troia rewards need later runs.

steps.title: 05 Trilobyte → 06 Man-O-War
steps.text: Use X + Axl in Metal Valley; activate the crane and get the visible metals. Crystal Wall and Plasma Gun now enable most remaining returns.

steps.title: 07 Yeti → 08 Rooster
steps.text: Use X + Zero at Yeti for Hermes Head. Use X + Axl at Rooster for Hermes Legs, T Breaker’s copy route, and the high Weapon Tank room.

steps.title: Follow the grouped cleanup
steps.text: Develop T Breaker before Rooster’s breakable floor. Make separate Yeti and Troia visits for rewards requiring different teams or scores.

routes.name: Completionist · all development and special forms
routes.subtitle: Normal / Hard + New Game+
routes.description: All 28 field locations first; then develop chips and plan the final blow.

steps.title: Follow the same eight-boss route
steps.text: Collect armor and Rare Metals; no one-time rescue roster exists in X8. A wrong team or missed item can be fixed on a return.

steps.title: Earn both Troia prizes
steps.text: Complete one run with 5–7 top-row results and another with all eight. These are separate Rare Metals, not two rewards for one perfect run.

steps.title: Buy Metal Discount before expensive upgrades
steps.text: Find its metal with charged Crystal Wall in Metal Valley. Build the discount, then buy expensive defensive chips and optional weapons.

steps.title: Prepare Axl before Lumine
steps.text: Reach 100% on Axl’s chip screen; bring him to the final stage and finish Lumine’s last form with Axl active. Save a spare pre-final file.

steps.title: Continue the clear file into New Game+
steps.text: Finish X and Zero’s development, buy the Sigma Blade, and unlock the special forms. Navigator weapons are additional purchases; field collection alone is not full R&D completion.

flowIntro: Each row names X’s weakness weapon. Equivalent Axl weapons and Zero techniques are listed below. Vile can interrupt stages; resume the pickup route after the encounter.
basicsHtml:
R&D, armor and switching hunters
  • Life Up chips replace loose Heart Tanks. Life Tanks and the Weapon Tank are built at R&D after their Rare Metal unlocks are found.
  • Only X opens capsules. Equip Icarus/Hermes components on Neutral Armor at team selection; individual parts work immediately. Matching all four Icarus parts adds Giga Crash; all four Hermes adds X-Drive.
  • Charged Crystal Wall methods need X with a Buster part that supports charged special weapons. This route gets Buster I at Noah’s Park first.
  • Axl copies compatible enemies by finishing them with Copy Shot. Select the resulting A-Trans form before entering small or spiked passages.
  • Tag out a hurt hunter to recover the red portion of health. Keep them in reserve until recovery finishes. Change Character also breaks many grabs.
  • Collected items survive death, but save progress at the base before closing. Use the return-to-R&D option when available after a pickup.

checkpoints.title: AFTER 01 · Get Icarus Buster
checkpoints.text: Noah’s Park reopens after a Maverick clear. Its Buster part enables charged special-weapon returns.
checkpoints.stageText: Visit Noah’s Park with X + Zero before continuing the route.

checkpoints.title: RETURNS UNLOCKED · Crystal Wall + Plasma Gun
checkpoints.text: You now have the tools for hidden ground metals and the Pitch Black generator.
checkpoints.stageText: R&D purchases and generator returns are now available; complete the loop or take the listed detours.

returnIntro: Each level opens once to show all its relevant cards. Follow the team/loadout notes: some levels need two visits because no pair can perform every method. First develop the Rare Metal unlock at R&D when another pickup requires that equipment.
completionText: 8 capsules: Icarus 4/4 + Hermes 4/4 · 20 Rare Metals, including Noah’s Park · develop both Life Tanks and Weapon Tank. Buy Life Ups for the hunters you use; purchases are separate from field collection.
